entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: One of the five elder dragons of Tarkir, a feral lightning-breathing dragonlord who leads clan Kolaghan.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of the dragons and clans.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker whose dragon tempests produced the dragons.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who saved Ugin in the current timeline.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: The clan that revered Kolaghan's brood; later renamed clan Kolaghan.

entities.name: Clan Kolaghan
entities.description: The reckless, honorless clan that grew from the Mardu under Kolaghan's rule.

entities.name: Khanfall of Tarkir
entities.description: The event in which the dragonlords banned khans and old clan names.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that caused heavy dragon casualties.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A former planeswalker who found the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: A ritual that summoned a dragonstorm and five spirit dragons, defeating the dragonlords.

entities.name: Spirit dragons
entities.description: Five dragons that emerged from the ritual and bound with the new clan leaders.

events.summary: In the original timeline Kolaghan's brood lost to the clans after Ugin's death; Kolaghan smashed into the cliff at Wingthrone and her skull became the Mardu khan's throne.
events.quote: her skull was used as the throne of the Mardu khan

events.summary: In the current timeline Kolaghan joins the ban on the word khan and the old clan names.
events.quote: Kolaghan participated in the ban on the words "khan" and the names of the old clans

events.summary: Under Kolaghan's reign the Mardu name is forgotten and the group becomes clan Kolaghan.
events.quote: the group became known as clan Kolaghan

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion and reduced dragonstorms weaken the dragonlords, letting humanoid rebellions grow.
events.quote: The humanoid rebellions were able to gain traction

events.summary: Narset uncovers the Stormnexus Ritual and is convinced by the rebellion leaders to use it.
events.quote: she uncovered a spell scroll for the Stormnexus Ritual

events.summary: The ritual summons five spirit dragons; the dragonlords fight them and are defeated, swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: In the end, the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

relations.quote: The dragonlord became a fearsome leader

relations.note: One of Tarkir's five elder dragons.
relations.quote: is one of the five elder dragons of Tarkir

relations.note: Narset's ritual helped defeat the dragonlords.
Saved Ugin in the current timeline.
relations.quote: After Ugin was saved by Sarkhan Vol
